**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **Section 3.19 "Exclusivity Commitment of SFJ"** (p0369–p0374) is the only competing-product restraint in the Agreement, and it binds **SFJ and its Affiliates**, not PB — a restriction on the counterparty, which favours us and is not flagged. The supporting definitions ("Competing Product" p0057, "Brilinta Competing Product" p0029, "Exclusive Period" p0085, ending Nov 2022/Nov 2024) run only against SFJ.
- **PB-side covenants checked and cleared:** Article 7 negative covenants (7.5.1 indebtedness, 7.5.2 subordinated debt, 7.5.3 encumbrances/negative pledge, 7.5.4 distributions and Prohibited Investments, 7.5.6 royalty-stream sales, 7.5.7 further negative pledges) are financing/collateral protections, not restraints on what businesses we operate or products we build or buy.
- **Section 7.5.5 Licensing Transactions** is a consent right over out-licensing/transfer of PB Intellectual Property in the Product, gated by a "Material Impact" reasonableness standard and expedited arbitration, and expressly carves out Excluded Licensing Transactions — including licences of PB's own ELP technology (PB1046, PB1023) — which PB may do "without SFJ's consent". That is a licensing/transfer restriction properly assessed under the licensing/assignment rules, not a non-compete or field-of-use restraint, so we do not double-flag it here.
- **Section 15.15** reserves to PB all rights not expressly granted to SFJ, reinforcing the absence of any field-of-use limit on us.

No redline proposed.
